misprints.note: Extra τ in the print; kept as printed.
Headword 'Värdi, τακτὴ τιμή' printed so; kept.
Genitive ending printed without accent; kept bare as printed.

uncertain.note: Mark over the ι of the genitive ending looks like an acute but is small; could be bare ιδος.
Accent on οῦ read as circumflex.
